?/?	a/b	match	dot=false
bz	a/b/z/.a	no-match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_match_a_path_segment_for_each
*/*/*	aaa	no-match	dot=false
*/*/*	aaa/bb/aa/rr	no-match	dot=false
aaa*	aaa/bba/ccc	no-match	dot=false
aaa**	aaa/bba/ccc	no-match	dot=false
aaa/*	aaa/bba/ccc	no-match	dot=false
aaa/*ccc	aaa/bba/ccc	no-match	dot=false
aaa/*z	aaa/bba/ccc	no-match	dot=false
*/*/*	aaa/bbb	no-match	dot=false
*/*jk*/*i	ab/zzz/ejkl/hi	no-match	dot=false
*/*/*	aaa/bba/ccc	match	dot=false
aaa/**	aaa/bba/ccc	match	dot=false
aaa/*	aaa/bbb	match	dot=false
*/*z*/*/*i	ab/zzz/ejkl/hi	match	dot=false
*j*i	abzzzejklhi	match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_support_single_globs
*/*/*/*/*	a/a/a/a/a/a	no-match	dot=false
a/*/*	b/a/a	no-match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_only_match_a_single_folder_per
*/**/a	a	no-match	dot=false
*/**/a	a/a/b	no-match	dot=false
*/**/a	a/a	match	dot=false
*/**/a	a/a/a	match	dot=false
*/**/a	a/a/a/a	match	dot=false
*/**/a	a/a/a/a/a	match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_work_with_file_extensions
a/**/*.txt	a/x/y/z	no-match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_match_slashes_when_defined_in
foo{,/**}	foo	match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_correctly_match_slashes
a/**/b	a/a/bb	no-match	dot=false
*/**	foo	no-match	dot=false
**/	foo/bar	no-match	dot=false
**/*/	foo/bar	no-match	dot=false
*/*/	foo/bar	no-match	dot=false
**/	a/a	no-match	dot=false
*/**	foo/	match	dot=false
**/*	foo/bar	match	dot=false
*/**	foo/bar	match	dot=false
**/	foo/bar/	match	dot=false
**/*/	foo/bar/	match	dot=false
*/**	foo/bar/	match	dot=false
*/*/	foo/bar/	match	dot=false

## picomatch.stars_single_stars_should_optionally_match_trailing_slashes
**/*	foo	match	dot=false
**/*{,/}	foo	match	dot=false
**/*{,/}	foo/	match	dot=false
**/*{,/}	foo/bar	match	dot=false
**/*{,/}	foo/bar/	match	dot=false

## picomatch.wildmat_git_tests_basic_wildmat_features
*f	foo	no-match	dot=false
??	foo	no-match	dot=false
bar	foo	no-match	dot=false
foo\*bar	foobar	no-match	dot=false
\??\?b	?a?b	match	dot=false
*ab	aaaaaaabababab	match	dot=false
*foo*	foo	match	dot=false
???	foo	match	dot=false
foo	foo	match	dot=false
*ob*a*r*	foobar	match	dot=false

## picomatch.wildmat_git_tests_should_support_recursion
-*-*-*-*-*-*-12-*-*-*-m-*-*-*	-adobe-courier-bold-o-normal--12-120-75-75-/-70-iso8859-1	no-match	dot=false
-*-*-*-*-*-*-12-*-*-*-m-*-*-*	-adobe-courier-bold-o-normal--12-120-75-75-X-70-iso8859-1	no-match	dot=false
*X*i	ab/cXd/efXg/hi	no-match	dot=false
*Xg*i	ab/cXd/efXg/hi	no-match	dot=false
**/*a*b*g*n*t	abcd/abcdefg/abcdefghijk/abcdefghijklmnop.txtz	no-match	dot=false
*/*/*	foo	no-match	dot=false
fo	foo	no-match	dot=false
*/*/*	foo/bar	no-match	dot=false
*/*/*	foo/bb/aa/rr	no-match	dot=false
foo*	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
foo**	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
foo/*	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
foo/**arr	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
foo/**z	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
foo/*arr	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
foo/*z	foo/bba/arr	no-match	dot=false
XXX/*/*/*/*/*/*/12/*/*/*/m/*/*/*	XXX/adobe/courier/bold/o/normal//12/120/75/75/X/70/iso8859/1	no-match	dot=false
-*-*-*-*-*-*-12-*-*-*-m-*-*-*	-adobe-courier-bold-o-normal--12-120-75-75-m-70-iso8859-1	match	dot=false
**/*X*/**/*i	ab/cXd/efXg/hi	match	dot=false
*/*X*/*/*i	ab/cXd/efXg/hi	match	dot=false
**/*a*b*g*n*t	abcd/abcdefg/abcdefghijk/abcdefghijklmnop.txt	match	dot=false
*X*i	abcXdefXghi	match	dot=false
foo/*	foo/bar	match	dot=false
foo/bar	foo/bar	match	dot=false
**/**/**	foo/bb/aa/rr	match	dot=false
*/*/*	foo/bba/arr	match	dot=false
